title: Can Virat Kohli Score 100 Centuries? His Tally and Real Chances in 2026
seoTitle: Can Virat Kohli Score 100 Centuries? Tally and Odds 2026
seoDescription: Virat Kohli has 86 international hundreds (55 in ODIs) and plays only ODIs now. See his tally, the maths of 14 more and whether 100 is still possible.
excerpt: Kohli's updated century count by format, why retiring from Tests and T20Is changed the maths, how many ODIs India have left before the 2027 World Cup, and an honest verdict on whether 100 is still possible.
